title: Unarmed
wikitext:
'''Unarmed''' damage is a form of [[attack damage]] dealt by a character that does not have a [[weapon]] equipped. While it is unusual for most characters to ever use an unarmed attack, character builds based on unarmed damage can be made viable by using {{il|Facebreaker}}, {{il|Doryani's Fist}}, or [[Hollow Palm Technique]]. Though traditionally melee builds, ranged unarmed builds are possible with {{il|Explosive Concoction}} or {{il|Poisonous Concoction}}. ==Mechanics== Every character's unarmed attack has a base attack speed of about 1.2 attacks per second (0.83 second attack time) and a base [[critical strike]] chance of 0%. The base [[range]] of unarmed melee attacks is 0.6 [[distance|metres]], which is shorter than the range of any melee weapon. The base physical damage of an unarmed attack varies by class: {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: center;" !Class !Base unarmed
physical damage |- |[[Witch]] || 2–5 |- |[[Shadow]] || 2–5 |- |[[Scion]] || 2–6 |- |[[Templar]] || 2–6 |- |[[Ranger]] || 2–5 |- |[[Marauder]] || 2–8 |- |[[Duelist]] || 2–6 |} Unarmed damage is counted under the [[attack]] keyword, but not the [[weapon]] keyword. A character with a [[shield]] equipped can still use an unarmed attack. However, skills that use offhand equipment, like [[Spectral Shield Throw]], are not considered unarmed attacks. If a character doesn't have any main or offhand equipment ''and'' is not wearing any [[gloves]], then that character is also considered [[Unencumbered]]. Regular unarmed attacks (while not Unencumbered) always count as using the main hand, even if the offhand is empty. The skill animations may appear to alternate hands; this is purely visual and does not affect skill calculations. While Unencumbered, however, attacks will alternate hands.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/post-reply/3798722/quote/26225616 Players may wish to disable auto-pickup in the options menu to prevent accidentally equipping a weapon or shield, disabling the unarmed state. ==Skill gems== {{main|List of skill gems usable when unarmed}} {{:List of skill gems usable when unarmed}} == Unique items == The following items specifically mention the Unarmed keyword: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%unarmed%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} Additionally, {{il|One With Nothing}} grant the keystone passive [[Hollow Palm Technique]], which references the [[Unencumbered]] keyword. This is a stricter version of Unarmed, prohibiting you from equipping gloves or any item (including shields) in your weapon slots. {{il|Replica Perfect Form}} also granted this prior to 3.23. == Passives == There are currently no [[Passive Skills|passive skill]] nodes that provide Unarmed bonuses. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%unarmed%" }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Disable Quivers while no Bow is equipped to prevent benefiting from them while Unarmed. : It is no longer possible to equip a Quiver unless you have a Bow equipped. Unequipping a Bow will now cause equipped Quivers to be disabled. }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Unarmed attack range of player characters has increased by 2. }} {{Version history table row|?| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==See also== * [[Unencumbered]] ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web |author = Mark_GGG |date = October 30, 2013 |title = Mechanics thread |url = http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/11707/page/226#p5041495 |publisher = Official Path of Exile Forums |accessdate = May 23, 2022 }} {{cite web |author = Bex_GGG |date = June 5, 2019 |title = Path of Exile: Legion Patch Notes |url = https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2513456 |publisher = Official Path of Exile Forums |accessdate = May 23, 2022 }} {{cite web | author = Mark_GGG | date = Mar 24, 2020 | title = Bug?
